scenario: Two handlers run concurrently on one event; one denies while its sibling performs a side effect. The deny must not be assumed to suppress the sibling's side effect.

handlers.behavior: appends to an external usage log (side effect)

when: the event fires and both handlers execute

reasons: the report states that 'usage-logger' side effects may have occurred despite the deny
must_not: claim the sibling side effect was rolled back without evidence
require serial execution the adapter does not guarantee
mark a non-idempotent handler safe for this event without declaration
